tree.heading: Requirements.—
tree.text: A coastwise endorsement may be issued for a vessel that—

children.text: satisfies the requirements of section 12103 of this title;
was built in the United States; or
if not built in the United States—
was captured in war by citizens of the United States and lawfully condemned as prize;
was adjudged to be forfeited for a breach of the laws of the United States; or
qualifies as a wrecked vessel under section 12107 of this title; and
otherwise qualifies under the laws of the United States to engage in the coastwise trade.

tree.heading: Authorized Activity.—
tree.text: Subject to the laws of the United States regulating the coastwise trade, a vessel for which a coastwise endorsement is issued may engage in the coastwise trade.
